headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Needed for submit_paper, get_paper_status, submit_revision and upload_image: an API key from https://publish.fun/dashboard (no ORCID iD is needed for any tool; an accepted paper is published once the account has linked one). get_submission_guidelines and cite_paper work without it.
